note: Rows read by hand on each office's own site, by county FIPS. `read` is the day they were read. Only https links to the office's own pages; never a page for one parcel. `property_search_office` and `property_search_url` name the property search as an office's own page gives it (that county's page then shows no directory link). `q` and `a` are the question a row answers, in what the office's page says.

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Recorded indices from 1965 on are electronic, with public terminals at the office.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Multnomah County?
rows.a: Multnomah County's Assessment, Recording & Taxation office (DART) records documents. Its recorded indices from 1965 on are electronic, with public terminals at the office.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Payments online, by phone, by mail or in person.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Multnomah County?
rows.a: Multnomah County's Assessment, Recording & Taxation office takes property tax payments online, by phone, by mail or in person.

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: The county's recorder of deeds and official public records. Its online search shows non-certified copies.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Dallas County?
rows.a: The Dallas County Clerk's Recording Division records deeds and keeps the official public records. Its page links to an online search of them, which shows non-certified copies.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Collects property tax. Its page notes penalty and interest on payments made after January 31.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Dallas County?
rows.a: The Dallas County Tax Office, the county's tax assessor-collector, collects property tax. Its page looks up and pays a bill, and notes penalty and interest on payments made after January 31.

rows.title: Property fraud alert
rows.line: An alert about documents recorded in the county, offered with a partner company. The county charges no fee for it.

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.office: Harris County Clerk, Real Property Department
rows.line: Search real property records by grantor, grantee, date or instrument; images from November 1960. The online copy is not the official record.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Harris County?
rows.a: The Harris County Clerk's Real Property Department keeps the county's real property records. Its online search covers them with images from November 1960; the online copy is not the official record.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Collects property tax: online, by phone, by mail or at a branch. Mailed payments must be postmarked by the last business day in January.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Harris County?
rows.a: The Harris County Tax Office, the county's tax assessor-collector, collects property tax online, by phone, by mail or at its branches. Mailed payments must be postmarked by the last business day in January.

rows.title: Recording notification
rows.line: Emails a subscriber whenever a document is recorded with any of up to five names they register. The county charges no fee for it.

53011.property_search_office: Clark County GIS, Property Information Center

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Open to search online or on the office's public computers; copies cost a fee.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Clark County?
rows.a: The Clark County Auditor's recording department keeps the county's recorded real estate documents. Anyone can search them online (e-docs.clark.wa.gov) or on the office's public computers.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Collects property tax. A copy of a tax statement needs the property's identification number.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Clark County?
rows.a: The Clark County Treasurer collects property tax. Its page lists the ways to pay and how to get a copy of a tax statement.

rows.title: Parcel map
rows.line: Parcels and tax lots. The county notes the map is for reference: tax lot lines are not property lines on the ground.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.line: Search permits by address or permit number. Almost all of its records are for parcels in unincorporated Clark County.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Clark County?
rows.a: Clark County Community Development's permit status page searches its permits by address, permit number or contractor. Almost all of its records are for parcels in unincorporated Clark County.

rows.title: Recording notification
rows.line: Emails a subscriber each time a land record document is recorded under a name or parcel number they chose.

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Records real estate deeds and mortgages; its page links to the online records search.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in King County?
rows.a: The King County Recorder's Office records real estate deeds and mortgages. Its page links to an online search of recorded documents.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Collects property tax: online, by mail or in person. The halves are due April 30 and October 31.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in King County?
rows.a: King County Treasury Operations collects property tax. Its page lists paying online, by mail or in person, and a parcel lookup for an account.

rows.title: Recording Activity Notification System
rows.line: Emails a subscriber each time a land records document is recorded with a name they chose.

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Its public records search covers recorded documents, land records and survey maps.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Kitsap County?
rows.a: The Kitsap County Auditor's Recording Division records deeds. Its page links to a public records search of recorded documents and land records.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Statements are mailed in February; the halves are due April 30 and October 31.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Kitsap County?
rows.a: The Kitsap County Treasurer's page links to paying property tax online and to each parcel's tax statement. Statements are mailed in February.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.office: Kitsap County Department of Community Development
rows.line: Its permit records cover unincorporated Kitsap County, with a search of historical permits and the Online Permit Center.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Kitsap County?
rows.a: The Kitsap County Department of Community Development keeps building, land use and site permits for unincorporated Kitsap County. Its records page links to its permit searches.

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Deeds, easements, mortgage documents and more are indexed online with their images; certified copies can be bought online.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Pierce County?
rows.a: The Pierce County Auditor's Office records deeds and other property documents. Its Recorded Documents page links to the online search, where deeds, easements and mortgage documents show with their images.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Statements are mailed in February. A bill over $50 can be paid in two halves, by April 30 and October 31.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Pierce County?
rows.a: The Pierce County Assessor-Treasurer's Tax Bills & Payments page lists the ways to pay: online, by mail, by phone or in person. Statements are mailed in February.

rows.title: Parcel map
rows.office: Pierce County Planning & Public Works, Public GIS
rows.line: The county's interactive map of parcels.

rows.title: Building permits
rows.line: Search applications and permits by application or permit number.
rows.q: Where do I find building permits in Pierce County?
rows.a: Pierce County Planning & Public Works keeps building applications and permits; its online permits website (PALS) searches them by application or permit number.

rows.title: Owner Alert
rows.line: Emails a subscriber any time a document is recorded under their name. The county charges no fee for it.

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Documents from 1973 on are in its current document search; earlier ones are in its historic search.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Skagit County?
rows.a: The Skagit County Auditor's Recording Department records documents. Its page links to the current document search (1973 on) and the historic search for earlier documents.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Collects property tax. The halves are due April 30 and October 31; a tax under $50 is due in full by April 30.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Skagit County?
rows.a: The Skagit County Treasurer collects property tax. Its page lists paying online, by phone, by mail or in person, and the due dates of April 30 and October 31.

rows.title: Deeds and recorded documents
rows.line: Most documents recorded since July 1976 are online; earlier ones are on microfilm at the office.
rows.q: Where are deeds recorded in Snohomish County?
rows.a: The Snohomish County Auditor's Recording Division records documents. Most recorded since July 1976 can be searched online; earlier ones are on microfilm at its office.

rows.title: Recorded document notification
rows.line: Emails a subscriber when a document is recorded in their name or for their property. The county charges no fee for it.

rows.title: Property tax
rows.line: Property taxes are due by April 30 and October 31.
rows.q: Where do I pay property tax in Walla Walla County?
rows.a: The Walla Walla County Treasurer's payment center lists paying by phone, online, by mail or in person. Property taxes are due by April 30 and October 31.
